data.long_meaning: The name Attenweiler is derived from the German words 'atten' meaning 'at' or 'towards' and 'weiler' meaning 'settlement' or 'farmstead'. This name was often given to individuals who lived near or settled at a farm or place of agricultural significance. The name Attenweiler carries the meaning “Farmstead settler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, German. Parents who choose Attenweiler usually hope their child will grow to embody farmstead settler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
